elements.caption: Non-Residential Vapor Intrusion Screening Concentrations - Trichloroethane to Ethyl Acrylate
elements.summary: This table lists non-residential vapor intrusion screening concentrations for various contaminants, providing Ground Water Screening Levels, Sub-slab and Exterior Soil Gas Screening Levels, and Indoor Air and Crawlspace Screening Concentrations at different Target Cancer Risks and Target Hazard Quotients.

content.text: Based on June 2015 USEPA Regional Screening Level Target Air Concentrations and the USEPA VI Screening Level Calculator.
TCR = Target Cancer Risk; THQ=Target Hazard Quotient; C= Carcinogenic; N = Non-Carcinognic
